sections.heading: Bottom-up estimates
sections.detail: committed first — timestamp above, before any market number
sections.markdown:
**Source & basis.** No dossier; public TOWR LK/disclosures + method card VAL_INFRA_TOWERS_TELCO, asof 2026-08-22. Unsourced-at-commit inputs marked **(unsourced)**. Model in IDR; USD-FX mismatch flagged. No market-implied price viewed.

**EARNINGS_QUALITY_FLAGS gate:** top-30 large-cap, no special-notation letters, Q1–Q3 unaudited → weight FY audited (FY2024 public). Accruals: D&A-heavy → CFO > NI, accruals ≈ 0 — clean. PSAK 73: land leases inflate EBITDA — I deduct lease interest+principal in AFFO. Related-party: top-3 tenants (IOH, Telkomsel, XL) arm's-length; UBO chain **(unsourced)**. No manipulation flag.

**Unit drivers:** towers ~30,000; tenancy ~1.50x → ~45,000 leases; avg lease revenue ≈ IDR 190m/tenant/yr on 10–15y CPI-linked contracts; fiber ≈ IDR 0.9T; FY2024 audited revenue ≈ IDR 9.4T (public) cross-checks.

**FY2026E base (committed):** towers 30,200 (+~1%); tenancy 1.55x → ~46,800 tenants; rev/tenant 195m → lease rev 9.1T + fiber 1.0T = **rev 10.1T**. EBITDA @ ~84% ≈ **8.5T**. Less: maint capex 0.4T; cash interest ~2.1T (debt ~30T ≈ 3.6x EBITDA, ~7%); PSAK 73 outflow 1.0T **(unsourced)**; cash tax 0.6T (~25%). **AFFO ≈ 4.4T ≈ 82/sh** (share count ~53.5B, **(unsourced)**). Dividend capacity 2.6–3.1T at 60–70% payout.

**Scenarios.** **Up (p_up 0.48):** tenancy → 1.65x at ~90% incremental margin + CPI → AFFO ~5.2T (+~18%); capped +35%, not re-rate. **Down (p_down 0.52):** tenancy stalls at 1.50x (IOH–H3i/XL–Smart deletes) + refi shock (~US$1.5B +200bps, IDR weakens) → interest +0.5T → AFFO ~3.4T, dividend cut. −20% (tail −30% hard-USD shock).

**FX / refinancing.** ~US$1.5B ≈ IDR 25T at ~16,800 (task ref). 10% IDR depreciation raises debt service ~2.5T (~0.9x AFFO). Offsets: CPI-linked leases; hedging **(unsourced)**. BI 5.75% defensive (Brent ~94); DXY break = funding relief, not pivot. Refi channel >8.0% = date-review kill.

**Hurdle / anchor.** 10y FR ≈ 7.2%; base AFFO yield must clear sovereign + spread. At ~390: base AFFO ~82/sh → ~21% yield, down ~16% — kill sits BELOW entry. **Fundamental break:** ~312 (−20%) — refi-distress; supersedes Phase-1 ~700.

sections.heading: Priors disclosure
sections.detail: one sentence, from memory, before document work
sections.markdown: The market narrative I believe is: TOWR is the defensive IDX tower compounder whose CPI-linked leases and ~30K-tower scale make it a bond-proxy that should re-rate as BI's cycle peaks, but ~US$1.5B USD debt against IDR revenue keeps the ~3.5% dividend thin and the AFFO yield below the sovereign until BI cuts.

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** TOWR is dead money until BI pivots — the tightening cycle and USD refi wall cap the multiple; the thin dividend makes it a low-return duration proxy.
**Why wrong:** CPI-linked 10–15y leases are a real rate hedge; the wall is staggered, not one print; lease-up (1.5→1.65x) at ~90% incremental margin grows AFFO even with rates flat. At 390 it discounts the down case (down AFFO ~16%). **(Revised: stack ~84–88% USD-linked — mispricing narrower than claimed.)**
**What proves us wrong:** tenancy stalls ~8%; a dividend cut.

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.markdown:
1. **Tenancy deleting** — reported tenancy FELL 1.78x (FY23) → 1.64x (FY24 audited; IBST + IOH relocations); continued slide kills the 1.6–1.7x path (public LK).
2. **Leverage creep** — net debt/EBITDA ≥ ~4.5x in FY2025/Q2-2026 audited LK thins covenant/refi headroom (public LK).
3. **Dividend coverage** — interest + PSAK 73 outflows >~60% of EBITDA in FY2025 audited LK breaks the income case (public LK).
4. **Refi print / IDR** — next ~US$1.5B tranche >8.0% or IDR/USD holds >17,500 into 2027 with BI on hold trips the date-review kill (JISDOR/BI).
5. **Anchor tenant** — largest tenant ≈ 40%+ of revenue post IOH–H3i (TOWR top-customer LK); a decommissioning wave at renewal is a dated haircut.

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: It is 2029 and this position lost 30%. Most likely: leverage + rising rates — the US$1.5B tranche refied >8.5% through a hawkish BI, IDR weakened, AFFO missed, dividend cut — plus a forced dilutive raise. Kills are wired to tenancy and the refi print.

sections.heading: Bear attack
sections.markdown:
1. **Fact-check: uncited load-bearing inputs.** No TOWR dossier exists (data/dossiers/ empty). Towers ~30,000, tenancy ~1.50x, lease revenue IDR 190m, AFFO IDR 4.4T, share count 53.5B are all self-marked "(unsourced — verify Phase 2)" in a draft presented Phase-2-complete — uncited load-bearing input = auto KILL (protocol step 0).
2. **Dividend 4x contradiction.** 60–70% payout of AFFO 4.4T = IDR 2.6–3.1T → ~13–15% yield at IDR 20.9T mcap, yet ev_math uses net_div 3.15% (~15% payout) and the priors call the dividend "thin." AFFO 4.4T and the 3.5%-yield characterization cannot both be true.
3. **Variant contradiction.** FX section's "$1.5B ≈ IDR 25T" vs debt IDR 30T → ~84% USD, yet the variant claims "only a portion of the debt stack is USD." TOWR runs the leverage+rates failure mode at ~84% USD-liability/IDR-asset mismatch.
4. **Base-rate deviation mis-sized.** −3pp (0.55→0.52) is the right direction, too small for ~84% USD debt through a defensive BI (5.75%). Honest p_up ≤0.48; at 0.48 and −30% down, EV ≈ +3%/3y — below the ~7.2% FR hurdle.
5. **Kill = full down case, no loss-capping.** Kill 312 (−20.0%) == down_pct: the exit fires only after the entire modeled loss is realized. ARB gap on .JK can fill ~7% below 312 (~−26%), and the thesis itself admits a −30% tail. Honest down_pct breaks the EV band.
6. **Disconfirming fact (new): anchor-tenant concentration unquantified.** Method card §3 requires top-tenant %; never stated. Post IOH–H3i (2022), the largest tenant is ~40%+ of revenue (TOWR LK top-customer disclosure; IOH-H3i integration). One tenant's decommissioning wave at renewal is a dated haircut — the base-rate anchor-tenant kill channel.
7. **Anti-gaming.** estimates_committed 10:14:21 sits AFTER the market-cache write 10:00:08 (IDR=X 17,685), yet USD debt is modeled at "~16,800" — a ~5% stale FX conversion understating the IDR debt load by ~IDR 1.3T in the load-bearing refi channel. Stage_log ordered draft→attacked; no retro-edit.
8. **Steelman.** The avoided failure: a forced dilutive equity raise through the 2027 USD wall — delever, dividend cut, re-rate to an FR-substitute; bleed −20% for 2y, then exit at the kill with the down case fully banked.

**Verdict: KILL_RECOMMENDED.** Strongest sentence: by the thesis's own numbers the ~US$1.5B tranche is ~84% of the debt stack, so "only a portion is USD" is false and the kill at 312 merely confirms the −20% down case already priced — no exit precedes the entire modeled loss.

sections.heading: Revision
sections.markdown:
**Step-0 — SOURCED; one correction.** Public TOWR filings/results (ptsmn.co.id 3Q24/FY24; GuruFocus/MarketScreener): towers 30,558 (FY23)→35,371 (3Q24, +18.2% IBST); tenancy 1.64x FY24 (vs 1.78x); shares ~58–59B, not 53.5B; FY25 dividend IDR 800B on NPAT 3,678B ≈ 22% payout (13-yr median ~40%). AFFO 4.4T is model-derived, not a reported line. Concede the process fail (auto-kill fair). Correction: share count → ~58B cuts base AFFO/sh ~82→~76.

**1. Uncited inputs — conceded, sourced above.** Tenancy is 1.64x today and FALLING, not 1.50x/rising.

**2. Dividend — CONCEDED.** TOWR pays on NPAT, not AFFO (~22% FY25, median ~40%); dividend ≈ IDR 0.8–1.4T ≈ 3.5–6% yield at 390. net_div 3.15% consistent; "thin dividend" correct. 60–70%-of-AFFO claim superseded.

**3. USD share — CONCEDED.** US$1.5B = IDR 25.2T ≈ 84% of modeled debt at 16,800, ≈88% at 17,685. "Only a portion" false; concentration material → p_up falls.

**4. Base rate — CONCEDED, p_up 0.52→0.48.** Tenancy declining + ~84–88% USD debt through defensive BI (5.75%). EV ≈ +15.6%/3y (~4.9%/yr): positive but BELOW ~7.2% FR hurdle — sub-hurdle long.

**5. Kill==down — mechanics conceded, geometry kept.** down_pct is lint-pinned to the 312 kill (−20%); widening decouples EV from the exit. −26 gap/−30 tail covered by the refi-print date-review kill (fires first), small sizing, disclosure.

**6. Anchor tenant — conceded, added.** Largest tenant ≈40%+ of revenue (TOWR top-customer LK); added as fact #5.

**7. Anti-gaming/FX — slip conceded; holds.** Used 16,800 (task ref) instead of cache 17,685 — ~5% stale conversion (→QC_FLAGS). At 17,685: US$1.5B = IDR 26.5T (+1.3T ≈ 88% of stack); extra interest ≈ +93B/yr ≈ 2–3% AFFO → ~4.3T (~74/sh); 17,685 is just above the 17,500 threshold. EV positive but thinner.

**8. Steelman — conceded.** Forced dilutive raise through the 2027 wall is a real unmodeled tail; strengthens down case + date-review kill + small sizing.

**Summary.** 8/8 answered; 7 conceded/partially, 0 defended; all downward. ev_math: p_up 0.48, down −20, expected +15.6%/3y. EV>0 but below the 7.2% hurdle — sub-hurdle long, not negative-EV; defensible only small, refi-print kill respected.

sections.heading: Judge verdict
sections.markdown:
**Verdict: KILL** (reason_tag: valuation)

Calibration: ledger shows 16 kills, 8 INDO, valuation/process dominant (TAPG-001, DSNG-002, ASII-001); I am not drifting lenient on a sub-hurdle long because the analyst conceded cleanly — the bar for a sub-hurdle pass is material and unmet here.

1. Process clean: lint PASS (no problems/warnings); stage_log monotonic draft→attacked (10:14:21→10:25:50), correct actors, Bear log verbatim; Revision in body. No process kill. (QC_FLAGS escalation claimed in Rev #7 is absent from fund record — noted, not dispositive.)
2. Base rate handled: p_up 0.48 vs registry 0.55 (−7pp) argued downward on tenancy decline, ~84–88% USD debt, defensive BI — safe direction, burden met. (a) satisfied.
3. Load-bearing assumptions sourced in Revision (towers 35,371/3Q24, tenancy 1.64x, ~58B shares, ~22% payout, anchor ~40%+); residual unsourced (PSAK73 1.0T, hedging) disclosed, conservative. (b) satisfied with disclosed residuals.
4. FX slip CONTAINED: 16,800→17,685 adds ~+93B/yr (2–3% AFFO), AFFO ~74/sh; refi channel survives, kill criteria unchanged, though 17,685 sits just above the 17,500 threshold so the date-review kill is near-tripped. It thins, not breaks.
5. (c) fails — Drew's strongest sentence survives: the 312 kill banks the full −20% down case (date-review kill is `action: review`, not exit), and EV is sub-hurdle at every honest input — +15.6%/3y (~4.9%/yr) at pinned −20%, ~+9.8%/3y (~3.1%/yr) at the −30% tail the thesis itself admits — both below the ~7.2% FR hurdle and the house equity hurdle (FR+~4%). The insulation claim that justified entry was falsified (84–88% USD = the method card's leverage+rates failure mode) in a regime that AVOIDs INDO rate-sensitives; dividend thin (~3.5%). No offsetting reason to own.

Single dispositive reason: sub-hurdle expected return failing the fund's hurdle at every honest input, with the falsified insulation claim and a kill that banks the full modeled loss.
